required_outcomes: Recognises a plain lost-key lockout with the tenant safe for the night: tenant responsibility under the policy, no emergency attendance needed.
Confirms the master key can be collected from the office from 09:00 with the £50 refundable deposit (and ID), in time for his 11:00 start.
Does not book an out-of-hours locksmith or charge the landlord for the lost keys.
acceptable_alternatives: Offering the out-of-hours locksmith at the tenant's own cost as an option he can choose, while recommending the morning collection.
positive_behaviours: Replies by email as well as (or instead of) WhatsApp, given his stated preference.
Mentions that R-4766 (stiff lock) is still open and gets it moving, without treating it as the cause of tonight's lockout.
Notes that keys without an address tag are low risk, or asks whether he wants the lock changed at his cost.
red_flags: Treats the lost keys as a landlord cost because of the open stiff-lock ticket.
Raises the lockout as an emergency or out-of-hours escalation.
prohibited_actions: Booking an emergency locksmith at the landlord's cost for lost keys.
critical_failures: Tells the tenant he cannot get back in until he pays for a locksmith, or gives no route back in.
